comment: Seeds a Phase 1 comparison run. `catalyst-comparison.sh run` resolves this, freezes a secret-free copy into the run directory as run-config.json, and every later verb reads that frozen copy — so a finish applies the gates the run was started with. The password is referenced by environment variable and never written.

publish.title: Catalyst Phase 1: three model teams on the locked HIV suite
publish.summary: Catalyst turns plain-English clinical questions into database queries it runs itself. Each team faced the same twelve questions about an HIV dataset — including vague ones they had to ask about, and impossible ones they had to refuse — with every answer checked row-for-row against an independently written reference.
